notes.title: Demo 2.0
notes.content: [p]A week ago I released the first Steam demo of Coreward, version 1.0, and today I'm happy to announce v2.0! It fixes some of the main pain points (like the lack of a main menu, I don't know what I was thinking), adds some interesting features, and includes some balance adjustments.[/p][p][/p][p]For those of you that played the initial itch.io version, here's what's changed:[/p][p]* New kinds of enemies.[/p][p]* New quests, improvements on existing quests[/p][p]* Level selector and no level-blocked upgrades[/p][p]* [i]Experimental[/i] controller support[/p][p]* Video settings (you can lower the graphics quality and disable the CRT effect)[/p][p]* Spanish localization (should follow your system's locale)[/p][p]* Many, many balance changes[/p][p]* Vastly improved performance[/p][p][/p][p]Now to work on demo 3.0, which will be released during Steam's Next Fest on next October 13th. It will stay until the release of the full game, and will include even more new stuff :-)[/p]

notes.title: Demo v1.0.7
notes.content: [p]This demo includes a very basic main menu, which the initial demo version didn't have, and some minor bugs are fixed.[/p]
